fields: L5 Shanghai / Dragon Boat Festival (e-bike; Lujiazui → the Bund → Huaihai Road → Xintiandi). Same item fields as L3 v3.1 / L4. Pools keep L3 names so pickSetL2 + l3TypeUniq can be reused: seawall = 端午摊 Zongzi Stall questions (3–4 choices, timed 30 s; also the retry pool), forest_fork = fork signs (≤3 choices; sign_en/sign_zh; EN ≤24 chars, ZH width ≤12), peak_final = Xintiandi-entrance final (exactly 4 choices, hard, situational). Per run: 3 timed stall in segment 1 + 4 fork in segment 2 + 2 timed stall and 1 Xintiandi final in segment 3 = 10 (one stall pool, drawn as 5 then split 3+2; do not place all 5 timed questions in the first segment). Every item has qtype + qtype_zh (each qtype at most once per run). {name} = player name; English on top, Chinese below. No subject capybara/beaver. Festival riddles are object/animal riddles solvable in both languages (subject 'riddle'), labelled Festival riddle: / 端午谜：. Stems are deduped against all L1–L4 banks (all grades).

questions.q_zh: {name} 在粽子摊数零钱：有 3 张十元、4 张五元和 5 个一元硬币，一共多少元？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Flora has 43 zongzi and Bara's basket holds 15. How many more does Flora have?
questions.q_zh: Flora 有 43 只粽子，Bara 的车篮里有 15 只，Flora 比 Bara 多几只？
questions.qtype_zh: 比较相差（多多少/高多少）

questions.subject: duanwu
questions.q_en: Flora rides her e-bike to the Xintiandi door. The doorman hands her a warm ____.
questions.q_zh: Flora 骑电动车来到新天地门口，礼宾递给她一只热的____。
questions.explain_en: The doorman welcomes her with a warm zongzi.
questions.explain_zh: 礼宾用一只热粽子迎接她。

questions.subject: nature
questions.q_en: On Huaihai Road, Flora must duck on her e-bike because of low ____.
questions.q_zh: 在淮海路上，Flora 骑电动车时要低头，是因为低低的____。
questions.explain_en: Low plane-tree branches hang over the road, so she ducks.
questions.explain_zh: 梧桐低枝垂在路上，所以要低头。

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Near Xintiandi, Flora buys 2 zongzi at 7 yuan each and pays with 20 yuan. How much change does she get?
questions.q_zh: 在新天地附近，Flora 买了 2 只粽子，每只 7 元，付了 20 元，应找回多少元？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Along the Bund there are 3 dragon-boat teams, each with 5 paddlers. How many paddlers are there?
questions.q_zh: 外滩边有 3 支龙舟队，每队有 5 名桨手，一共有多少名桨手？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: At the Bund, 54 race flags are shared equally by 9 dragon-boat teams. How many does each team get?
questions.q_zh: 在外滩，54 面比赛旗平均分给 9 支龙舟队，每队几面？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: The dragon-boat race by the Bund starts at 8:10 and ends at 8:30. How many minutes does it last?
questions.q_zh: 外滩边的龙舟赛 8:10 开始，8:30 结束，一共多少分钟？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Flora sees 2 square-shaped flags on a dragon boat by the Bund. How many sides do they have altogether?
questions.q_zh: Flora 在外滩的龙舟上看见 2 面正方形的旗子，它们一共有几条边？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: The Bund had 332 festival visitors today. Round 332 to the nearest hundred.
questions.q_zh: 今天外滩的节日游客有 332 人，把 332 四舍五入到百位。
questions.explain_en: 332 rounded to the nearest hundred is 300.
questions.explain_zh: 332 四舍五入到百位是 300。
